Signed as one route under signed rulings of 2026-10-05 (vault D-319): ruling 3 for the default (CI-ROUTE-029) and the fisher_z alias for the explicit request (CI-ROUTE-034). R's own method = "wald" for rho is a different route ('.confint_rho:wald') and is not in this class.
